steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ... And that concludes my report of Rhodes Island's combat operations.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: And your assessment?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: There is little reason to doubt their strength.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: However, Chief Wei, given their identities, I believe that from a strategic standpoint...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ... the L.G.D. is more than capable of handling the job.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: When it comes to fighting crime and prevent infiltration, the L.G.D. is more than sufficient.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Rhodes Island may be able to bring more to the table. However...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Of the things that Rhodes Island has requested, there is one 'item' that we are unwilling to exchange based upon what has been offered.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The temporary defense cooperation that you're providing is far from equal value. As things stand, your 'asking price' is a bit too high.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Miss Kal'tsit, Miss Amiya, I hope you two both understand.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mister Wei, a temporary defense will not be enough. There are a lot of things about Reunion that you don't know about.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Based upon the data we gathered while fighting them, if no proactive measures are taken, Reunion will seize control of Lungmen within two weeks.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ... Nonsense. There's no evidence of that--

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, would you like to know the real reason Chernobog fell within one night?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Please elaborate.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah... Sure.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island wasn't just involved in the Chernobog incident... We also were caught inside the Catastrophe, and survived.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Impressive, impressive.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: It's not every day I meet someone crazy enough to have made it out of a Catastrophe alive. Miss Amiya, please continue, I'm listening.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ... We fought against Reunion's leader.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Hmm? What's her name again?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I don't recall clearly...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Ah, right, Talulah.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, what do you think?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I... I know.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ... This is what happened to Rhodes Island at Chernobog. Even though Reunion managed to wrest control of Chernobog from Ursus...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But in order to expand, they'll have to deal with their resource shortages. Lungmen will be their next stepping stone.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even though you might be able to fend them off for a while, their attacks will not cease unless you handle this situation proactively.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Furthermore... There's another unknown factor - we still don't know how Ursus will respond after losing Chernobog...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Hahaha... Well spoken, young lady.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Due to the seriousness of this threat and the L.G.D.'s limited manpower, I'm not opposed to considering this temporary agreement based on the terms that were detailed earlier.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But what I said before still holds...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ... Rhodes Island's asking price is still too high?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: In order to make sure Lungmen is properly compensated, I have two very simple conditions.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: First, Rhodes Island will help the L.G.D. suppress the Reunion threat. This includes identifying threats within Lungmen as well as those related to fallout from Chernobog.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: This also includes assessing the degree that the Infected have infiltrated Lungmen. I expect that you will share any potentially helpful information with us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What's the second condition, then?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I will tell you about the second condition after you've satisfied the first.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Naturally, I won't ask for anything outside of Rhodes Island's area of expertise.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm not sure I understand. Could you please elaborate, Mister Wei?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: How should I put this... If Reunion causes damage that surpasses Rhodes Island's estimates...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I hope that you will help the L.G.D. handle the situation, which may include post-disaster management. Of course, nothing beyond your capabilities. That's roughly the gist of it.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I cannot say much more at this point. However, don't forget, Rhodes Island doesn't have a choice.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: If you can't accept our terms, then all the conditions we discussed, as well as your requests, will be...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mister Wei, I would like to add one more clause to the agreement...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: 'Any interpretation of the clauses must be agreed upon by both parties.' Is this acceptable?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Oh... Of course. I can see your respect to Lungmen, Miss Amiya.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, do you have any objections?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ... I accept this operation.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: It seems like Madam Ch'en also has her own goal now.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: In any case, congratulations. You've earned Lungmen's trust. Madam Ch'en will be responsible for your arrangements.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: However, be aware that the Infected are not allowed to freely move around within the city, as that may cause panic.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I hope that you will defer to the L.G.D.'s orders while carrying out your duties.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Especially, Madam Ch'en's orders.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Lungmen will be open to Rhodes Island, as long as your actions are in line with us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Phew... Ugh...! That man was so difficult...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He was so methodical when he spoke, and it felt like he couldn't be swayed by anything...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, you'll eventually have to learn how to deal with these people yourself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But in the end, you did a great job.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ehehe...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: By the way...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You...

options: Please to meet you, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, please don't give Dr. {@nickname} a hard time...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: *inhales sharply*...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Haah...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I hope our sacrifices... weren't in vain.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hello, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Welcome back.
